title: ST /api/characters/create flat body
description: Exact flat field list accepted by ST's characters/create endpoint (src/endpoints/characters.js, charaFormatData). cook.py render/validate check every create-body key produced from a recipe against this list — additionalProperties:false so a stray or misspelled field fails loudly instead of silently landing in a V1 field ST ignores. 'world' MUST be '' at create time (st_create_character forces this); a non-empty value embeds a dead character_book. Link a lorebook afterwards via st_merge_character on data.extensions.world.

extensions.description: JSON-stringified object, NOT a nested object — st_create_character serialises the dict for you.

world.description: Always '' at create time; link the lorebook after create via st_merge_character({avatar, data: {extensions: {world: <name>}}}).
